_note: When each Act 1 story trigger fires (Storie). Keys are bark triggers, log keys, dialogue ids, puzzle text paths (<puzzle>.<key>) and notes. A key used for two types is listed twice as id#type. at = step onto that square; on_facing = tap or first view while facing that square (from = squares you face it from). repeat: once = once per save; once_per_floor; every = every time; pool = repeating flavour (unused line each time until the pool is spent, per bark_rules.json); until_freed = see fire. Coordinates are (x,y) from levels/src/act1.py.

enter_floor1.fire: on arriving on floor 1 for the first time

enter_floor2.fire: on arriving on floor 2 for the first time

enter_floor3.fire: on arriving on floor 3 for the first time

enter_floor4.fire: on arriving on floor 4 for the first time

water_dry.fire: stepping from water onto dry stone

deep_water.fire: each step into deep water (flavour, rate-limited)

bump_wall.fire: walking into a wall; at most once per 2 s, alongside the bump sound

pantry.fire: first step onto the pantry doorway (4,5), the gap in the west wall of the pantry room (x5-7, y5-7). Needs bark:"pantry" added on (4,5) in levels/src/act1.py (Levie)

enter_pantry.fire: same step as the pantry bark: first step onto (4,5)

guard_hall_enter.fire: first step onto (9,2), the arch into the guard hall

lampkeeper_hooks_heard.fire: first step onto (8,6), mouth of the dark corridor (hook clinks start)

first_true_dark.fire: first step, on floor 3 or deeper, onto a square lit only by Wren's lantern (in floorNDark, or a square no torch reaches, e.g. the F3 mess hall after the bowl). In practice F3 lower bunk room (x5-12, y11-12)

first_singing.fire: first step into water (shallow or deep) on floor 2 after f2_singing has played

first_vent.fire: first time the vent (9,10) is in view: standing on (10,8) or (10,9) facing S, or on (10,10) facing W

singing_louder.fire: on stepping onto the stairs down (10,10); play before the floor transition

lever_found.fire: first time facing the hidden lever (3,2) from (4,2)

glass_door.fire: same step as f2_glass_door, just before it opens: (6,7)

grate_voice.fire: same step as f3_grate_tam, just before it opens: (9,9)

mess_hall.fire: first step into the mess hall (x1-5, y1-5); in practice (5,3) through the door (6,3)

armoury.fire: first step into the armoury through the parted water door: (4,8) or (3,8)

tam_below.fire: on stepping onto the stairs down (3,11); play before the floor transition

tam_tally.fire: first step onto (12,10), first view of the cell

carving_start.fire: tap the carving at (1,6); you face it from the start square

carving_door.fire: tap the carving on the locked door (4,2) from (5,2)

carving_secret.fire: tap the glowing plate at (5,1) once the secret wall is open

secret_found.fire: tap/push the secret wall (5,1) from (5,2); it opens

door_locked.fire: tap or bump the locked door (4,2) without the key

door_unlocked.fire: tap the locked door with the key

chest_empty.fire: open a chest with nothing in it. Chest contents are not defined yet (Levie)

read_lampkeeper_note.fire: tap the desk (12,9) while facing it; then show note_lampkeeper

lampkeeper_note_read.fire: after the note closes the first time

note_lampkeeper.fire: tap the desk (12,9); a second tap closes it

lampkeeper_capped_lamp.fire: tap the capped lamp prop (13,9) while facing it

pickup_scroll.fire: pick up a journal page (F1 5,1 = page 1; F2 3,9 = page 2)

read_journal.fire: after pickup_scroll on F1: then journal_act1.json page 1, line by line

journal_f2.fire: after pickup_scroll on F2: then journal_act1.json page 2, line by line

oil_pickup.fire: pick up an oil flask (unless oil was 0: then lantern_lit instead)

torch_snuffed.fire: snuff a lit wall torch (Take/Snuff choice: Snuff)

torch_take.fire: Take a lit wall torch into a free hand

torch_place.fire: put a held torch into an empty bracket

torch_dunk.fire: drop a held torch into water; it goes out

oil_empty.fire: first time a relight is tried with 0 oil (the toast stays "No oil to spare." as a short log)

lantern_out.fire: oil reaches 0; lantern falls to ember reach (never fully dark)

lantern_lit.fire: oil goes from 0 to 1 or more

lantern_gutter.fire: the f4_tam_cell oil choice is taken (cost lantern: guttering_for_floor): ember-only reach until you leave floor 4

torch_draws_monster.fire: ACT 2 ONLY (act:2): first time a light-drawn monster turns toward a lit torch. Ignored in Act 1

leech_drain.fire: a latched leech drains a hero (each tick)

leech_latch.fire: a leech latches onto a hero

leech_latch#bark.fire: a leech latches onto a hero (flavour)

floor_cleared.fire: the last monster on the floor dies (not during the F4 escape)

first_sight_keep_rat.fire: first keep rat in view; suppresses new_monster

first_sight_rust_crab.fire: first rust crab in view; suppresses new_monster

first_sight_bog_leeches.fire: first bog leeches in view; suppresses new_monster

first_sight_drowned_dwarf.fire: first drowned dwarf in view (F3 patrol); suppresses new_monster

new_monster.fire: first sight of a monster type with no first_sight_ lines (slime, cellar_spider, captain_dural)

low_health.fire: a hero drops below 30% max HP; re-arms for that hero once healed above 30%

tut_hand.fire: first time a monster is next to the front row (first fight starts)

tut_front.fire: first tap on a greyed back-row melee hand; if none by the end of the first fight, play then

tut_sheet.fire: 3 s after the first fight ends, once tut_hand and tut_front have played

not_ready.fire: tap a hand that is still recovering

out_of_reach.fire: tap melee on a back-row hero

idle.fire: 45 s with no input, not in combat or dialogue (flavour)

pickup_potion_red.fire: pick up a red potion (F1 at (6, 3))

desc_potion_red.fire: right after the first pickup_potion_red; also the bag description

pickup_potion_blue.fire: pick up a blue potion (F1 at (5, 5))

desc_potion_blue.fire: right after the first pickup_potion_blue; also the bag description

pickup_potion_green.fire: pick up a green potion (F1 at (7, 7))

desc_potion_green.fire: right after the first pickup_potion_green; also the bag description

loot.fire: any item pickup with no tutorial/story bark on the same pickup (flavour)

tut_inventory.fire: first item into the bag (normally the key)

f2_frogcatcher.fire: step onto (3,10) facing E. First visit starts at node "a". Every later visit (re-arms when you leave the square) starts at node "return", while frogcatcher_freed and frogcatcher_drowned are both unset. Sets met_hobb.

f4_captain.fire: step onto (9,4); fight branch runs start_fight:captain_dural

f4_tam_cell.fire: step onto (12,11) facing W; then f4_tide_wakes

f4_tide_wakes.fire: right after f4_tam_cell; ends with start_escape

tam_left.fire: first escape checkpoint (12,13), only if saved_tam == false

floor2_vents.lever_plate.fire: first time facing either vent lever (4,6)/(5,6) from (4,5)/(5,5); again on each tap

floor2_vents.lever_pulled_dry.fire: a lever pull drains a zone

floor2_vents.lever_pulled_flood.fire: a lever pull floods a zone (shown after _dry; each pull does both)

vent_page_flooded.fire: a pull floods the stores nook while journal page 2 is still at (3,9). If Hobb is still trapped there, frogcatcher_drowned plays instead and this one is skipped

frogcatcher_drowned.fire: a pull floods the stores nook before frogcatcher_freed is set; sets frogcatcher_drowned. Line picked by met_hobb

floor3_offering.lantern_carving.fire: tap the carving (5,8) while it is inside lantern light; same text as log carving_bowl

floor3_offering.bowl_examine.fire: tap the bowl (5,7) without a lit torch in hand

bowl_first_sight.fire: first time facing the bowl (5,7) from (6,7) or (5,8)

floor3_offering.bowl_lit.fire: a held lit torch is placed in the bowl; sets f3_bowl_lit, water door (4,8) parts

bowl_lit.fire: same moment as floor3_offering.bowl_lit (one random line)

floor3_offering.room_dark.fire: right after bowl_lit: the mess hall goes dark

riddle_first_sight.fire: first time facing the riddle door (8,4) from (7,4) (both lines, in order)

floor4_riddle_door.wrong_item.fire: anything but a lit torch or Wren's lantern used on the altar (7,5)

riddle_wrong.fire: first wrong item on the altar

floor4_riddle_door.solved.fire: lit torch or Wren's lantern on the altar (7,5); door (8,4) opens

floor4_drill_tiles.wall_carving.fire: tap the carving (3,10); same text as log carving_drill

floor4_drill_tiles.step_ok.fire: step on the next correct plate

floor4_drill_tiles.step_wrong.fire: step on a wrong plate; sequence resets

floor4_drill_tiles.solved.fire: sequence shield, hammer, hammer, oath done; rack (2,12) opens

checkpoint.fire: step onto (12,13) or (8,13) during the escape; autosave

act1_end.fire: step onto the stairs (5,9) after start_escape; end card

met_hobb.set: any choice in f2_frogcatcher (node c, ask2, return)

frogcatcher_freed.read: vent puzzle (Hobb drowns or not); f2_frogcatcher re-entry; Hobb removed

frogcatcher_drowned.set: vent puzzle: stores flooded before frogcatcher_freed
frogcatcher_drowned.read: frogcatcher_drowned bark; f2_frogcatcher never fires again

saved_tam.set: f4_tam_cell (true or false, store false explicitly)

f3_bowl_lit.read: water door (4,8) opensOn; mess hall dark

f4_captain_done.set: f4_captain ends with captain_spared, or captain_dural dies

start_escape.read: stairs (5,9) gate, water timer, manual save off (title save_blocked)
